entries.defaultValue: JavaScript with pm.variables, pm.request, pm.response, pm.test, pm.expect, pm.crypto and console. pm.crypto provides sha256, hmacSha256 and UTF-8 base64. pm.environment and pm.collectionVariables are aliases for session variables; changes last until switching environments or restarting, not in the saved environment. Scripts run with a 2-second limit; filesystem, network APIs and npm imports are unavailable. This is a subset of the Postman scripting API.

existingTranslations.zh-CN: 支持 JavaScript、pm.variables、pm.request、pm.response、pm.test、pm.expect、pm.crypto 和 console。pm.crypto 提供 sha256、hmacSha256 和 UTF-8 base64。pm.environment 和 pm.collectionVariables 是会话变量的别名；修改在切换环境或重启前有效，不会写入已保存的环境。脚本限时 2 秒，不提供文件、网络 API 或 npm 导入。仅支持 Postman 脚本 API 的一个子集。
